app.name: Sentinel
app.metaDescription: Public analysis of Brazilian government procurement data to surface possible inconsistencies and unusual patterns worth human review.

common.disclaimer: Alerts flag possible inconsistencies for human review and do not constitute an allegation of wrongdoing.

shellCompanyFlag.low_capital: Share capital low relative to contract value

politicalLinkType.FAMILY_IN_SUPPLIER: Family member listed as supplier shareholder
politicalLinkType.DONOR_IS_SHAREHOLDER: Donor also listed as supplier shareholder
politicalLinkType.DONOR_CONCENTRATION: Donations to multiple politicians with contracts

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.disclaimer: Alerts flag possible inconsistencies for human review and do not constitute an allegation of wrongdoing.
alerts.empty: No alerts found. Run the analysis pipeline to surface points worth reviewing.
alerts.emptyFiltered: No alerts match the active filters.

sanctionedEntity.title: Supplier with public sanction on record and active contract: {supplierName}
sanctionedEntity.description: Company {supplierName} ({cnpj}) has sanction(s) recorded in {sources} and {contractCount} active government contract(s).

suspiciousNetwork.title: Shared shareholder between suppliers in the same procurement
suspiciousNetwork.description: Companies {entities} share the same shareholder (taxpayer ID: {shareholderCpf}) and took part in the same procurement "{procurementDescription}" of {orgName} — pattern worth reviewing.

aiFlag.title: AI analysis surfaced points to review: {orgName}

overpricingMarket.title: Price above reference median: {deviationPct}% above
overpricingMarket.description: Item "{itemDescription}"{contextLabel} priced at {unitPrice} is {deviationPct}% above the median {median} of PNCP price registries ({sampleSize} reference(s), confidence: {confidence}).

overpricingIqr.title: Price above reference median: {deviationPct}% above
overpricingIqr.description: Item "{itemDescription}"{contextLabel} priced at {unitPrice} is {deviationPct}% above the median {median} (sample: {sampleSize}, confidence: {confidence}, method: {method}).

overpricingBidEstimate.title: Winning bid above estimated value
overpricingBidEstimate.description: Winning bid {winningBid} is {deviationPct}% above the estimated {estimatedPrice}. Item "{itemDescription}" in procurement of {orgName}. {bidCount} bid(s) recorded.

overpricingBidSpread.title: Unusual spread between bids
overpricingBidSpread.description: Maximum bid {bidSpreadRatio}x the minimum bid (outside expected range). Item "{itemDescription}" in procurement of {orgName}. {bidCount} bid(s) recorded.

overpricingContextual.title: Price above the expected range for the scope: {deviationPct}% above
overpricingContextual.description: Item "{itemDescription}" ({kind}) in procurement of {orgName} with total value {totalPrice} is {deviationPct}% above expected ({expectedPrice}). Estimated range: {minPrice} – {maxPrice}, based on the described scope and similar contracts.

politicianShareholder.title: Politician listed as shareholder of a government supplier — link worth reviewing
politicianShareholder.description: {politicianName} ({party}/{state} - {position}) is listed as a shareholder of {entityName} (CNPJ: {entityCnpj}), which holds {contractCount} government contract(s) totaling {totalContractValue}.

supplierDonated.title: Supplier listed as campaign donor — link worth reviewing
supplierDonated.description: {entityName} ({entityCnpj}) is recorded as having donated {totalDonated} to {politicianName} ({party}) and holds {totalContractValue} in government contracts.

donorGotContract.title: Campaign donor recorded with contracts in the same jurisdiction — link worth reviewing
donorGotContract.description: {donorName} is recorded as having donated {totalDonated} to {politicianName} ({party}/{state}) and received {totalContractValue} in government contracts in the same region.

familyInSupplier.title: Person registered as politician's family member is listed as supplier shareholder — link worth reviewing
familyInSupplier.description: {shareholderName} ({relationshipLabel} of {politicianName}, {party}/{state}) is listed as shareholder of {entityName} ({entityCnpj}).

familyDonated.title: Person registered as politician's family member is listed as donor — link worth reviewing
familyDonated.description: {donorName} ({relationshipLabel} of {politicianName}, {party}/{state}) is recorded as having donated {amount}.

politicianServant.title: Politician on record as a federal public servant

wealthAnomaly.title: Unusual wealth variation between electoral declarations — verify
wealthAnomaly.description: {politicianName} ({party}/{state}) declared assets of {previousTotal} in {previousYear} and {currentTotal} in {currentYear} (variation of {growthPercentage}%).

donorIsShareholder.title: Campaign donor is also listed as a supplier shareholder — link worth reviewing
donorIsShareholder.description: {donorName} is recorded as having donated {totalDonated} to {politicianName} ({party}/{state}) and is listed as a shareholder of {entityName} ({entityCnpj}) with {totalContractValue} in contracts.

donationTiming.title: Donation and contract timed closely — link worth reviewing
donationTiming.description: {entityName} is recorded as having donated to {politicianName} and received a contract {gapMonths} months {direction} — {totalContractValue} in nearby contracts.

donorConcentration.title: Company recorded with donations to {politicianCount} politicians and government contracts
donorConcentration.description: {entityName} ({entityCnpj}) is recorded as having donated {totalDonated} to: {politicianNames} — holds {contractCount} contract(s).
